dedupe_keys.name: nepal housing recovery and reconstruction platform 4w who does what where 2015 to 2018

description: The Housing Recovery and Reconstruction Platform in Nepal kept a who-does-what-where (4W) inventory of housing reconstruction activities by partner organisations, and the national public version is on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. It records what housing reconstruction activities each partner planned and implemented, where at village development committee level, and when, with the number of beneficiaries or constructions, so that progress and impact can be measured. Method: partners fill a common template every two weeks with the help of district information management focal points; district data are validated, then compiled and cleaned at national level. Coverage: districts of Nepal where partners reported, from December 2015 to June 2018; the published workbook is round 58 of 25 June 2018. Access: one Excel workbook on HDX. Licence: Open Database License; free. Caveats: figures are partners' own reports, the platform is now inactive, and the page does not describe the columns. Simulation uses are observed timelines and spatial patterns of housing reconstruction for calibrating post-disaster recovery models. Related records: the GAR15 exposure datasets and the Shelter Cluster and HOT datasets for Nepal on HDX.
